title: FinCrime Escalations Officer
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Financial Crime Operations is at the forefront of Revolut’s efforts to keep customers and their money safe. Team members work directly with customers to resolve issues and flag potential concerns. Using cutting-edge technology and sharp attention to detail, they help prevent financial crime and keep trust at the core of Revolut.

We’re looking for an Escalations Officer to ensure effective and compliant suspicious activity reporting in Brazil. You'll be performing assessments and making decisions on cases, which are escalated from the first line of defence.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you’ll be doing


  • Acting as the escalation point for suspicious activity cases
  • Ensuring accurate and timely SARs are submitted according to local requirements
  • Responding to regulatory inquiries and other requests from local authorities related to SARs
  • Managing queries requiring a second line of defence review
  • Working with the MLRO and escalating significant cases
  • Monitoring and detecting rare or new patterns, and reporting emerging trends in suspicious activity
  • Resolving escalated cases, following expected resolution times
  • Participating in projects with management as required
  • Collaborating on training initiatives and implementation of new processes


What you'll need


  • Experience as a compliance/FinCrime officer in a major financial institution
  • Experience in FinCrime operations acting as the escalation point
  • Deep knowledge of AML and sanctions regulations
  • Experience using internal and external systems and databases to conduct investigations
  • The ability to review policies and procedures and advise if changes are required
  • Problem-solving and decision-making skills, with the ability to analyse complex information to identify the key issue/action and drive resolutions
  • The ability to present a summary and conclusion to management promptly, including clear proposals to implement appropriate steps to mitigate risk and/or monitor it
  • An understanding of payment systems and markets with a focus on technology and mobile applications
  • Fluency in English and Portuguese


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

title: Data Engineer III
description:
Posição temporária!


Visão Geral da Posição

A equipe de Analytics de BMP (Business Model and Pricing) está buscando um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados experiente para apoiar a gestão de desempenho do negócio e a tomada de decisões estratégicas por meio de infraestrutura de dados escalável e soluções de engenharia. A equipe trabalha em estreita colaboração com liderança, finanças, operações e stakeholders do negócio para viabilizar acesso confiável a dados de alta qualidade, apoiar análises avançadas e impulsionar ações orientadas por dados em toda a organização.

O(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados terá um papel crítico no desenho, construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados robustos, modelos de dados e ativos fundamentais que suportam analytics, relatórios e capacidades emergentes de IA/ML. Essa função exige forte rigor em engenharia, profundo entendimento de sistemas de dados e capacidade de colaborar entre equipes técnicas e de negócio.

O(a) candidato(a) ideal possui um histórico comprovado na construção de soluções de dados escaláveis em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais, e sente-se confortável equilibrando trabalho em plataformas de dados fundamentais com iniciativas em evolução de analytics e IA.


O que você fará

Você possui uma forte mentalidade de engenharia e resolução de problemas. Converte necessidades de negócio e analíticas em soluções e arquiteturas de dados escaláveis e confiáveis.

Projeta, constrói e mantém pipelines e modelos de dados escaláveis que suportam monitoramento de desempenho do negócio, analytics e relatórios, além de contribuir para o desenvolvimento da Base de Dados BMP em ambientes Hive, Snowflake e data lakes.

Apoia o desenvolvimento de produtos e aplicações de dados, incluindo contribuição em pipelines baseados em Streamlit e no desenvolvimento de capacidades de chatbot para melhorar o acesso e a interação com dados.

Colabora de perto com equipes de analytics, ciência de dados e áreas de negócio para garantir disponibilidade, qualidade e usabilidade dos dados para dashboards, relatórios e análises avançadas.

Viabiliza e apoia o desenvolvimento de analytics avançado, machine learning e capacidades de IA, garantindo que a infraestrutura, pipelines e ambientes necessários estejam disponíveis para o desenvolvimento e implantação de modelos.

Contribui para o design e evolução do ecossistema de dados e ML, ajudando a estabelecer infraestrutura, processos e fundamentos necessários para escalar iniciativas de IA/ML na organização.


Qualificações Mínimas

• Mestrado em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Dados, Engenharia ou área quantitativa relacionada.

• Mais de 5 anos de experiência em engenharia de dados, desenvolvimento de plataformas de dados ou funções relacionadas.

• Forte experiência com SQL e pelo menos uma linguagem de programação (Python ou equivalente).

• Familiaridade com frameworks de big data e processamento distribuído (ex.: Spark / PySpark).

• Experiência na construção e manutenção de pipelines de dados e trabalho com arquiteturas modernas de dados.

• Experiência com ferramentas de orquestração (ex.: Airflow) e automação de pipelines.

• Experiência com plataformas de dados em nuvem (ex.: AWS) e soluções de data warehouse (ex.: Snowflake).

• Sólido entendimento de modelagem de dados, qualidade de dados e governança de dados.

• Experiência com sistemas de controle de versão (Git) e fluxos colaborativos de desenvolvimento.

• Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas e capacidade de trabalhar com requisitos ambíguos.

• Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e capacidade de colaborar com stakeholders técnicos e não técnicos.

• Inglês fluente.


Qualificações Desejáveis

• Experiência com arquiteturas de data lake e ambientes de dados híbridos.

• Experiência com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA.

• Experiência contribuindo para documentação e plataformas de compartilhamento de conhecimento (ex.: Confluence).

title: Travel Consultant and Sales Manager
description:
About Us

Dehouche is a leading provider of luxury tailor-made travel to South America, specialising in unforgettable journeys for a discerning clientele. From custom-built wilderness camps to luxury city hotel buyouts and \"money can't buy\" experiences, we pride ourselves on exceptional service and creating memories that last a lifetime.

The Opportunity

We're growing our Rio de Janeiro team and hiring for two positions:

  • Travel Consultant - a senior sales role focused on converting enquiries into bookings and building lasting client relationships.
  • Sales Manager - a senior consultant who also leads, develops, and drives the performance of our consultant team.

Both roles share the same DNA: a highly personalised, authentic approach to selling, and a natural talent for understanding and anticipating client needs. If you're motivated by clients thanking you for the trip of a lifetime, we want to hear from you.

Travel Consultant - What You'll Do

  • Convert enquiries into confirmed bookings by crafting bespoke itineraries that genuinely excite clients.
  • Consult with clients to uncover their aspirations, budget, and motivations, and translate those into compelling proposals.
  • Pitch and close confidently, handling objections and guiding clients to a decision.
  • Build trusted, long-term relationships that drive repeat business and referrals.
  • Negotiate rates and added value with suppliers to keep our product competitively priced without compromising quality.
  • Stay ahead of the curve on destination developments, new openings, and emerging experiences across the region.

Sales Manager - What You'll Do

In addition to everything above, you'll:

  • Lead and develop our team of travel consultants, coaching on consultative selling, proposal craft, and closing.
  • Own the team's pipeline and forecast: track conversion, identify bottlenecks, and intervene early.
  • Set, review, and drive individual and team revenue targets.
  • Act as a senior point of escalation on complex or high-value enquiries.
  • Partner with leadership on commercial strategy, pricing, and supplier negotiations.
  • Help recruit, onboard, and shape the next generation of our team.

What We're Looking For (Both Roles)

You're a seasoned travel sales professional with a strong track record of selling high-value travel and consistently hitting, and exceeding, revenue targets. You know how to move a client from \"interested\" to \"booked\".

You're a natural closer. Confident pitching, comfortable talking about price, and able to create urgency without ever feeling pushy.

You have your finger on the pulse of South America: what's new, what's exciting, what clients can't find anywhere else.

You're commercially minded. You understand margin, negotiate well with suppliers, and price trips competitively while maintaining the level of luxury synonymous with our brand.

Your attention to detail is excellent. The trips you sell are executed flawlessly, and your written correspondence is consistently polished.

You're a team player. You share ideas freely and build strong relationships with clients, guides, and colleagues alike.

Additionally for the Sales Manager

  • Demonstrable experience leading or mentoring a sales team, with examples of how you've lifted individual or team performance.
  • Comfortable with numbers: pipeline reporting, forecasting, and conversion analysis.
  • The judgement to know when to coach, when to step in, and when to let your team run.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Demonstrable experience in travel sales, with a track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
  • Knowledge of South America as a destination is essential. Latin America and the Caribbean a plus.
  • Native-level English. Portuguese, Spanish, or other languages a plus.
  • Excellent communication, listening, and interpersonal skills.
  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
  • Resilient, self-motivated, and genuinely passionate about travel.
  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, Rio de Janeiro.

How to Apply

Email your CV, along with a short note telling us which role you're applying for and why, to .

title: Analista de dados sênior
description:
Sobre a DataEX:

Com 12 anos de atuação no mercado, a DataEX é uma consultoria especializada em Dados e IA , com parcerias estratégicas com Microsoft, AWS e Databricks , atuando em projetos de alto impacto para grandes clientes. Valorizamos a inovação, a colaboração, o desenvolvimento contínuo e a qualidade de vida , com incentivos para certificações e bem-estar.


Contexto:

Busca-se profissional para atuação como Analista de Dados Sênior em projetos estratégicos, com forte capacidade analítica, visão de negócio e profundo domínio de Power BI / Fabric , apto a atuar de ponta a ponta em iniciativas analíticas complexas, influenciando decisões estratégicas e apoiando o desenvolvimento do time.


Especialidades e domínio técnico em Power BI

  • DAX avançado : construção de métricas complexas, cálculo de KPIs, otimização de performance e boas práticas de escrita.
  • Power Query : transformação, limpeza e integração de dados a partir de múltiplas fontes.
  • Linguagem M : desenvolvimento e manutenção de scripts avançados para ingestão e transformação de dados.
  • Row-Level Security (RLS) : definição e implementação de regras de segurança e governança de acesso aos dados.
  • Data Visualization (Dataviz) : criação de dashboards claros, intuitivos e orientados à tomada de decisão, aplicando princípios de storytelling e UX em dados.
  • Modelagem semântica no Power BI : relacionamento entre tabelas, cardinalidade, direção de filtros e otimização do modelo.


Perfil técnico esperado

  • Sólida experiência em análise de dados e resolução de problemas complexos , com foco em geração de valor para o negócio.
  • Atuação como referência técnica , com experiência em mentoria, revisão de entregas e evolução de analistas .
  • Experiência na definição e implementação de estratégias analíticas , alinhadas aos objetivos organizacionais.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em modelagem dimensional (Star Schema, Snowflake).
  • Forte experiência no levantamento, entendimento e validação de requisitos de negócio , traduzindo necessidades em soluções analíticas escaláveis.
  • Vivência com Big Data , incluindo consumo e manipulação de grandes volumes de dados.
  • Experiência prática com Data Warehouses .
  • Experiência com Data Lakes / Lakehouses (ex.: Onelake, Azure Data Lake, Databricks ou similares).
  • Atuação em ambientes de nuvem (Azure , AWS, ou similares).
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e influência , com capacidade de traduzir dados em insights estratégicos para diferentes públicos.


Escopo de atuação

  • Conduzir o levantamento, validação e refinamento dos requisitos de negócio junto às áreas usuárias.
  • Definir, validar e evoluir a modelagem dimensional (conceitual, lógica e física).
  • Liderar projetos analíticos end-to-end , da concepção à entrega e sustentação.
  • Atuar em projeto de Migração para Power BI/Fabric
  • Desenvolver e implementar estratégias de análise de dados e visualização em Power BI.
  • Atuar em parceria com líderes de negócio para identificar oportunidades de análise e melhoria de processos .
  • Construir e apresentar dashboards, insights e recomendações executivas para stakeholders.
  • Garantir qualidade, governança e confiabilidade dos dados , promovendo boas práticas analíticas no time.

title: Gerente de TI
description:
Sobre a Empresa


Especialista em Seguros Inovadores, a Essor traz em seu DNA inovação, excelência, experiência e conhecimento técnico. Somos uma Companhia do Grupo SCOR SE, uma das maiores resseguradoras mundiais.

Como parte do time da INOVAÇÃO, você terá oportunidades de atuar nas mais diversas áreas, dando aos nossos colaboradores oportunidades de conhecimento e desenvolvimento únicos.


Descrição sumária


Gerenciar e assegurar a operação contínua e estável de sistemas críticos de emissão de apólices e gestão de sinistros, execução de atividades, iniciativas e projetos de infraestrutura, suporte ao usuário, ERP e Dados, visando a transformação, simplificação e otimização do ecossistema computacional da seguradora.


Apoiar o CIO em atividades e planos estratégicos, planos táticos e operacionais, buscando a entrega de soluções tecnológicas de apoio às demandas de negócio.


Identificar oportunidades e novas ferramentas para otimização da execução de projetos de TI e projetos corporativos, com análise de custo/benefício, comparação de eventuais soluções disponíveis no mercado em relação ao desenvolvimento/execução interna, implantar soluções definidas de acordo com as especificações funcionais e auxiliar na elaboração de prazos e orçamentos definidos.


Atribuições do Cargo


  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento da estratégia corporativa para transformação na qualidade e prestação de serviços providos pela área de TI para os usuários internos e externos, no alinhamento das metas e objetivos definidos pela área de TI com as metas corporativas;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de “roadmap” para execução de projetos do ponto de vista técnico de TI, seguido de elaboração e execução de plano de ação;
  • Assegurar a aderência das atividades de infraestrutura, ERP, dados e suporte às demandas das áreas de negócios da empresa;
  • Definição de métricas de desempenho da equipe e dos serviços prestados;
  • Identificar, viabilizar a implementação e gerenciar soluções de tecnologia internas e/ou externas para aumentar a eficácia e eficiência operacional, qualidade dos serviços e nível de governança da seguradora, de acordo com as necessidades identificadas/reportadas;
  • Gerenciar, em conjunto com o coordenador da área, o desenvolvimento da infraestrutura, da implantação e atualização de sistemas, softwares e de soluções de tecnologia;
  • Atender demandas do CEO, COO e do CIO e demais diretores quando solicitado;
  • Aplicar processos e políticas de governança da empresa e contribuir com melhorias;
  • Planejar, documentar, executar e testar estratégias e procedimentos de contingências, visando a segurança de dados e informações;
  • Auxiliar nas atividades de auditorias e continuidade dos serviços;
  • Manter monitoramento, avaliação de desempenho e qualificação das equipes, visando a manutenção da motivação, a fim de obter os melhores resultados das atividades da área e a busca pelas melhores soluções técnicas;
  • Buscar tendências de mercado e necessidades identificadas na seguradora para evolução tecnológica dos serviços e soluções ofertados ao mercado;
  • Relacionar-se com fornecedores de produtos e serviços de tecnologias, garantindo atendimento aos interesses e às necessidades da empresa;
  • Realizar gestão, acompanhamento e cumprimento dos contratos firmados pela área de TI;
  • Cumprir o orçamento anual previsto para a área de TI;
  • Gerenciar as interações com os provedores de soluções externas;
  • Participar de reuniões periódicas com a Diretoria de TI;
  • Produzir relatório mensal demonstrando resultados, incidentes e monitoramento das atividades em andamento;
  • Garantir integração de produtos e sistemas;
  • Auxiliar na validação de soluções técnicas;
  • Auxiliar na gestão, revisão e conclusão de pontos de auditorias;
  • Analisar e propor melhorias em relação a indicadores de ocorrências;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de normas e padrões;
  • Acompanhar o processo de homologação de equipamentos e softwares de soluções externas visando a transformação e inovação;
  • Conduzir reuniões com equipes de trabalho;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e implementação de workshops e treinamentos voltados para a fomentação da transformação & inovação no âmbito da seguradora.


Requisitos


  • Experiência mínima de seis (6) anos como Gerente de TI, com atuação comprovada em infraestrutura, redes e suporte (Service Desk), sendo desejável experiência no setor de seguros;
  • Vivência em projetos de transformação e simplificação digital de processos, gestão de mudanças e operações em seguros;
  • Experiência na definição de KPIs (tempos de resposta, resolução) e níveis de serviço (SLAs);
  • Domínio de ferramentas de ITSM (exp. Freshservice, ServiceNow).


Nível de instrução


  • Superior em Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas e/ou cursos afins;
  • MBA, Especialização ou Pós-Graduação em Gestão de TI, Transformação & Inovação e/ou áreas afins.

  • Inglês fluente;

Fluência em francês ou espanhol

Liderança de equipes técnicas, excelente comunicação, capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente multidisciplinar, dinâmico e sob pressão (especialmente em momentos de crises, como DR e Alta Disponibilidade), visão sistêmica, visão estratégica de negócio, tomada de decisão, negociação, organização, raciocínio lógico e resiliência.

title: Institutional relations manager

Operating in more than 20 countries, with over 3,000 employees from 30 different nationalities and an installed capacity exceeding 8,000 MW, the Group generates reliable and clean electricity across four continents through its fleet of 45 Powerships TM and 11 LNG vessels, providing employment to more than 10,000 people worldwide. Karadeniz Holding manages its Powership TM fleet under its international brand Karpowership, meeting between 10% and 100% of the electricity needs of the countries where it operates across Europe, Africa, the Americas, and Asia. - Continuously monitor and analyze the regulatory and institutional landscape of the electricity and natural gas sectors in Brazil, anticipating risks and opportunities,

- Coordinate licensing processes, authorizations, and institutional interactions required for project implementation, operation, and continuity (including Powerships and onshore assets),

WHAT DO WE OFFER?
- Hybrid working model,
- One day off on your birthday,
- Private health insurance (extended to dependents) and life insurance,
- Variable compensation package and performance-based bonus,
- Meal allowance + food allowance in line with market practices,
- Mobility benefits (transport allowance and parking policy),

- Multicultural environment with exposure to international projects,

We are committed to providing equal opportunities for all applicants, regardless of race, religion, language or gender and we crown our success with our diversity.

Implement and maintain a comprehensive risk management framework, covering credit, market, liquidity, operational, and technology risks.
Conduct prudential and capital risk assessments, including stress testing, scenario analysis, and capital adequacy evaluations.
Prepare and support regulatory disclosures required for virtual asset service providers (VASPs) and financial institutions.
Oversee Margin-Account Operations, including;
Development of policies governing margin lending and virtual asset collateral
Setting and reviewing maximum loan-to-value (LTV) ratios and haircut levels
Monitoring collateral valuation, capital add-ons and counterparty exposures
Ensuring compliance with client/institutional limits and capital requirements
Net-worth monitoring;
Review and monitor risk indicators across business functions, escalating material breaches or deviations to senior management and the Board.
Maintain independence from commercial and trading lines while ensuring collaboration with Compliance, Finance, and Operations.
Liaise with internal and external auditors, regulators, and governance committees on risk management and capital matters.
Support a risk-aware culture through training, communication, and continuous improvement of risk methodologies.
Deep practical knowledge in CMN Res. 4557/17 regarding the risk management structure, the financial structure and the information disclosure policy management.
Requirements:
Legally resident in Brazil.
Senior-level experience (minimum 7 years) in financial or prudential risk management, preferably within financial institutions, fintechs, or crypto/virtual asset firms.
Demonstrated independence from commercial functions and ability to operate as a second-line or independent control function. Strong knowledge of Central Bank of Brazil risk management regulations, capital adequacy standards, and VASP disclosure requirements. Expertise in market and liquidity risk frameworks, stress testing, and margin-account operations involving virtual assets.
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or related field; postgraduate qualification preferred.
Strong quantitative, analytical, and communication skills; fluency in Portuguese and English . Must meet fit and proper standards with no disqualifying factors , including: not to have been declared bankrupt or insolvent;
unblemished reputation;
knowledge of the line of business, the services to be provided and the crypto segment, as well as crypto market dynamics and the risks associated with those activities;
technical capability, compatible with the functions to be exercised.
not having been previously rejected or investigated by the Central Bank of Brazil within the past three years for submitting false, omitted, or inconsistent information in any authorization request

title: Landholder and reforestation delivery manager
description:
About Nature Co
Nature Co delivers nature-based solutions (Nb S) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. Nature Co has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market.
Nature Co is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits.
We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. Nature Co is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.
 
Role and responsibilities
The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for Nature Co’s projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality.
The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.
Primary roles and responsibilities include:
Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management
Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs); plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions.
Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current.
Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner.
Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements
Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks).
Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation
Lead closure of contract signatures.
Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within Nature Co’s data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records).
Reforestation delivery enablement
Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows).
Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation.
Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints).
Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards
Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with Nature Co policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos).
Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the Nature Co grievance mechanism.
Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date.
Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting
Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements.
Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture
Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met.
Stay current on emerging best practices in Nb S and carbon projects; proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.
Skills and attributes
To perform successfully in this role, you will have:
A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers.
Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science.
Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills
Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups.
Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams.
A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision.
A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners
Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects.
Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting.
A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.
Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.
Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or Bahia
Submission instructions
Email CV and brief cover letter to with subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager
Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Technical product owner
description:
ABOUT US
Syniti , part of Capgemini, tackles the hardest work in data for the world’s largest organizations. We combine intelligent software with deep data expertise to help the Fortune2000 tackle complex data challenges and drive measurable business outcomes with business-ready data.
Syniti’s Data First strategy transforms data from an afterthought into a strategic asset—unlocking insights, reducing risk, and fueling growth. With over 5,000 successful projects, we support the full data lifecycle through a unified platform for migration, quality, replication, matching, master data management, analytics, governance, and strategy.
Operating globally across industries, Syniti’s award-winning software, expert consultants give enterprises a unique edge in managing and maximizing their data.
Syniti’s cloud-native platform sets new standards in enterprise data management, combining powerful Saa S solutions with deep domain expertise. Designed for agility and scale, our technology helps customers accelerate digital transformation, drive innovation, and make confident decisions with trusted data. Every product enhancement is built to solve real business challenges—empowering organizations to unlock value from their data faster and more effectively.
THE ROLE
We are seeking a highly technical and execution‑driven Technical Product Owner to serve as the “engine room” of our platform. In this role, you will translate high‑level product strategy into clear, actionable, and technically sound work for engineering teams. You will bridge complex legacy ERP architectures (SAP S/4 HANA, ECC) with modern, cloud‑native, AI‑driven workflows across the Syniti Knowledge Platform. This role goes far beyond writing tickets — we are looking for someone who uses AI for deep research, builds mockup screens to define user journeys, and ensures the creation of the “Golden Record” through seamless end‑to‑end integration across cataloging, migration, quality, and governance.

What You’ll Do
Product Ownership & Agile Execution: Lead 2–3 scrum teams by owning and prioritizing the backlog for key SKP capabilities (Migrate, Replicate, Drive, Orchestrate). Run high-impact backlog grooming, sprint planning, and estimation sessions.
Modern Requirement Engineering: Translate strategy into crisp Epics and User Stories. Use AI-driven tools to accelerate documentation, explore ERP integration patterns, and generate edge-case test scenarios.
UX & Workflow Prototyping: Design mockups and wireframes (Figma, v0, Miro) to visualize data journeys. Ensure that both Data Stewards and Developers experience intuitive, world‑class workflows within SKP.
Lifecycle Integration: Partner with Architecture and Engineering to define functional and non‑functional requirements (scalability, security). Ensure seamless integration across the entire data lifecycle to eliminate duplication and unlock full platform value.
Quality & Acceptance: Collaborate with the PXQ team to define “What Good Looks Like.” Act as the final validation gate to ensure features meet enterprise standards and align with real‑world user behavior.
Operational Feedback Loop: Engage with Support and Customer Success to funnel production learnings into the backlog, ensuring continuous improvement based on real customer usage.
WHAT IT TAKES
The Technical Veteran: 5+ years as a Product Owner or Business Analyst working on enterprise data products. Strong understanding of data integration, replication, APIs, and cloud-native architectures (AWS/Azure).
The ERP Expert: Deep experience with SAP ecosystems and large-scale transformation programs. Understanding of MDM, Data Quality, and Governance “plumbing.” Experience with SAP MDG or Informatica is a major plus.
The Modern Builder: An AI-native thinker who uses LLMs to enhance productivity and research. Prefers mockups over long documents and thrives in visual communication.
The Agile Leader: CSPO-certified with demonstrated ability to manage risks, dependencies, and scope changes across distributed, multi-time‑zone teams.
The Academic: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related practical experience.
The Communicator: Able to clearly articulate complex data and replication logic to business users while also explaining product vision to engineering teams.
Key Skills Visionary Leadership: Ability to maintain a clear product vision, define objectives, and mentor teams toward business goals. Advanced Governance Concepts: Strong command of data management and governance principles, including hierarchy and survivorship rules. AI/ML Application: Experience using AI/ML tools for documentation automation, market trend analysis, and optimization of data‑matching or data‑cleansing logic. Visual Communication: Skilled at producing wireframes and process flows to ensure UX alignment. Technical Storyboarding: Ability to write precise user stories and acceptance criteria with zero ambiguity. Relationship Orchestration: Strong interpersonal skills to influence stakeholders and drive collaborative engagement.
Drive for Results: Relentless focus on delivering incremental value and ensuring release readiness in a fast‑moving environment.
Be fully aligned with our core values:
Think Big - Be courageous and bold. Aspire to greatness. Relentlessly pursue market innovation. Set the standard by which others follow. Create solutions that have a meaningful impact. Solve the challenges our customers don’t know they have.
Be Curious - Be a lifelong learner. Seek out new ideas to serve customers. Understand our competition and the world. Be permanently dissatisfied with the status quo. Challenge preconceptions. Focus on the future rather than yesterday.
Take Action - Be the first. Don’t wait. Take accountability. Inspire others by doing. Fail fast and learn from mistakes. Make a difference every day.
Stronger Together - Respect, trust and look out for each other. Celebrate diverse perspectives. Listen. Build connections and belonging. Act with integrity. Give back. One Syniti family.
By applying for this position, you acknowledge and consent to your image being captured (video or screenshot) for employment purposes, including during the hiring and onboarding process.
WHAT WE OFFER
Trust that you are proficient at what you do. At Syniti, you will find a supportive environment and access to learning tools, but micromanagement is not our thing.
Growth. We are growing rapidly and steadily solving the biggest challenges enterprise companies are faced with today. There was never a better time to join and grow with us. Most importantly, you will have the chance to shape our journey and share in our success story.
Support. We all rely on each other and enable each other to be successful. You won’t stand alone.
Curiosity and genuine interest in you. We all have our different stories, all equally fascinating, with each depicting a different journey, and we want to hear them all.
Recognition. We are the sum of individual achievements, and we always take the time to celebrate them.
An open organisation. Hierarchies are not our thing, and access is something we make sure of across the board. We are a family where everyone is just as important, everyone’s work is seen, and ideas are valued.
OUR COMMITMENT TO INCLUSION
At Syniti, we’re committed to creating a respectful, inclusive, and fair workplace where everyone belongs and thrives. We believe that diverse perspectives make us stronger — and we value the unique backgrounds, experiences, and voices each person brings to our team.
We welcome applicants based on their skills and potential, and we’re dedicated to ensuring equal opportunities for all, regardless of personal background. If you need accommodations during the hiring process, please let us know — we’re here to support you.

title: Able seaman
description:
Position: Able Seaman
Location: FPSO Marechal Duque de Caxias
About Us
MISC Group is a world-leading provider of international energy-related maritime solutions and services.
For over 57 years, we have built a dynamic, progressive, and innovative global brand, delivering the highest standards of maritime services and creating sustainable value for our stakeholders worldwide.
Job Purpose
The Able Seaman supports deck operations, ensuring proper maintenance and operation of deck equipment, lifting appliances, and lifesaving systems. The role contributes to cargo handling, emergency preparedness, and compliance with safety and operational standards onboard.
Key Responsibilities
Inspect, test, and operate survival craft, rescue boats, and other lifesaving appliances in accordance with the maintenance plan;
Assist in material handling and lifting operations onboard;
Support housekeeping activities and waste management, including proper segregation and disposal;
Operate pedestal crane for ship-to-ship operations in the absence of the designated Crane Operator (e. G., during rest periods), subject to required qualifications;
Operate electro-mechanical lifting equipment (excluding pedestal cranes);
Participate actively in emergency response activities, including fire drills, abandon ship drills, and other onboard emergency procedures;
Maintain lifeboats, liferafts, and other safety equipment in a state of readiness;
Ensure familiarity with all safety equipment and applicable procedures onboard;
Perform routine maintenance tasks such as chipping, painting, cleaning, and greasing;
Maintain deck equipment and carry out minor repairs as required.
Requirements
Valid certification as Able Seaman (in accordance with STCW requirements);
Previous offshoreexperience (FPSO or oil & gas environment preferred);
Experience with deck operations and lifting equipment;
Familiarity with safety procedures and emergency response onboard;
Good level of physical fitness and ability to work in offshore conditions;
Basic English communication skills (minimum intermediate level preferred);
Strong teamwork, discipline, and safety-oriented mindset.
Benefits
Meal and food allowances
Bradesco Health Insurance (extended to family members at no cost, with no co-pay)
Life Insurance
Annual Bonus
Private Pension Plan
Childcare Allowance
Note
This position is open exclusively to Brazilian citizens.
MISC is committed to diversity and inclusion and welcomes applications from professionals of all backgrounds.

Experiência como sales hunter

title: Senior voip engineer
description:
About the role
We are hiring a Senior Vo IP Engineer to help shape and evolve a large-scale real-time communications platform, including the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
This role sits at the intersection of telecom, networking, and software engineering , and requires practical, production-grade experience across all three. You will contribute directly to architectural decisions, build new services, and improve voice systems that customers rely on every day.
This is a developer role — not an integrator or operator position. We are looking for someone who has written code that routes, manipulates, and reasons about SIP traffic at scale.
What you'll do
Design and develop services for a production-grade real-time communications platform.
Build and maintain telephony applications using open-source and commercial platforms.
Contribute to and help lead the migration from legacy infrastructure to a modern architecture.
Design and implement call routing logic, SIP signaling flows, and media handling.
Troubleshoot complex issues in live voice environments — signaling, media, performance, and reliability.
Partner closely with operations and cross-functional engineering teams to ensure service stability and scalability. What we're looking for:
Required 5+ years as a developer building Vo IP / SIP systems — not solely operating or integrating commercial platforms.
Hands-on production experience with both layers of an open-source SIP stack: A B2 BUA / media server: Asterisk or Free SWITCH
A SIP proxy / routing layer: Kamailio or Open SIPS
Proven track record building and operating voice platforms in production.
Solid understanding of SIP signaling, dialog state, NAT traversal, and real-time media behavior.
Comfort reading and writing code, not only configuration.
Advanced English proficiency (written and spoken). Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Strong plus Python for automation, tooling, or service development. SQL and cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
Containerization technologies (Docker, Kubernetes).
Event-driven architectures and messaging systems (Kafka, Rabbit MQ, NATS).
Dev Ops and automation tooling (Terraform, Ansible, CI/CD pipelines).
Exposure to RTPengine, Homer SIP capture, Web RTC gateways, or SBCs.
Experience contributing to or maintaining infrastructure-as-code.
Why this role
Fully remote with a flexible working model.
Direct ownership of architectural decisions on a platform handling real production traffic.
High-impact migration project — your work shapes the next generation of the platform.
Tight, technical team where engineering quality is a first-class concern.
Continuous learning culture with support for training and development.

title: Technical recruiter (remote)
description:
About Reboot Monkey
Reboot Monkey is a global datacenter services provider headquartered in Haarlem, Netherlands, operating 24 green-powered facilities across 6 continents . We deliver colocation, IP transit, smart hands, remote hands, and managed datacenter services to clients worldwide. We are a lean, remote-first team building the infrastructure backbone of the internet. Our clients range from hyperscalers and carriers to enterprises and startups who need reliable, fast datacenter operations — 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
About the Role
Reboot Monkey operates 24 datacenter facilities across 6 continents. Every one of those facilities needs reliable, skilled Data Center Technicians (DCTs) who can execute Smart Hands and Remote Hands work to our standard. The quality of our DCT pool is the single biggest factor determining whether clients stay or leave.
As DCT Recruitment Specialist for the Asia-Pacific — covering India, Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania , your job is to build and maintain a world-class DCT pool in your region. You are not a generic recruiter — you need to deeply understand what makes a great datacenter technician . You know the difference between someone who can rack a server properly and someone who will strip a screw on the first try. This role requires someone who has either worked as a DCT or managed DCTs directly . You must know the work inside and out — structured cabling, cross-connects, hardware installs, decommissions, labeling standards, hot/cold aisle management. What You'll Do
Source, screen, and recruit Data Center Technicians across facilities in the APAC region
Conduct technical screening interviews — assess hands-on DC skills, not just resume keywords
Build and maintain a vetted DCT pool organized by location, skill level, availability, and reliability score
Verify technician credentials: certifications, references, and work history
Create and maintain DCT skill assessments and practical evaluation criteria
Coordinate onboarding of new DCTs: facility access, safety protocols, SOP training
Track DCT performance after deployment — build a feedback loop with the operations team
Continuously expand our DCT coverage to new markets and facilities in your region
Manage relationships with DCT staffing agencies where we use them
Maintain our DCT database with up-to-date availability, skills, and performance ratings
Requirements
3+ years of recruiting, talent acquisition, or team staffing experience (formal or informal — managing a DCT pool counts)
Ability to conduct technical interviews and assess hands-on datacenter skills
Knowledge of DC infrastructure: structured cabling, server racking, cross-connects, PDUs, environmental monitoring
Fluent written and spoken English
Organized and detail-oriented — managing a regional DCT database requires precision
Comfortable using spreadsheets, databases, or ATS tools to track candidates

title: Analista pleno estratégia e parcerias - estratégia e parcerias de tecnologia
description:
JOB DESCRIPTION
Nossa área de Tecnologia é um pilar fundamental dos nossos negócios, sendo responsável pela nossa transformação digital. Aqui criamos soluções tecnológicas sempre idealizando e desenvolvendo técnicas e processos de automação, seja para aprimorar a experiência de trabalho das nossas equipes ou aumentar a capacidade de entrega dos nossos produtos e serviços.
Sobre a área:
Na área de Estratégia e Parcerias de Tecnologia, você fará parte de um time apaixonado por inovação e transformação.
Juntos, atuaremos na identificação de novas oportunidades de mercado, na construção de modelos de negócio e na viabilização de parcerias que gerem valor sustentável. Apoiaremos transformações estratégicas e garantiremos a execução de iniciativas críticas para o negócio, conectando estratégia, processos e tecnologia. Buscamos pessoas com pensamento crítico, forte capacidade analítica, excelência em comunicação e apresentação, que estejam continuamente buscando conhecimento e familiaridade com o universo de tecnologia. Profissionais com habilidade para transitar entre estratégia, processos, tecnologia e negócio, assumindo um papel protagonista na estruturação, validação e escalabilidade de novas oportunidades, em colaboração com áreas internas e parceiros externos.
Diversidade:
Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação. 
Modelo de trabalho:
Híbrido - São Paulo/SP ou Rio de Janeiro/RJ
RESPONSIBILITIES AND ASSIGNMENTS
Como será seu dia a dia: Participar da construção de modelagem de novos negócios ou transformação de negócios existentes, desde o scouting de mercado até a conceituação de propostas e POCs;
Contribuir para a estruturação e avaliação de parcerias estratégicas, apoiando análises, negociações e alinhamento entre áreas internas e parceiros externos;
Promover a prontidão operacional de novos negócios através do desenho de processos de ponta a ponta, integrando estratégia, processos e execução;
Promover a introdução de inovações / Prospectar tendências de mercado e trazer referências externas;
Realizar benchmarking com cases de mercado para gerar recomendações para evolução da arquitetura e apoiar decisões de negócio;
Executar assessments de arquitetura (diagnósticos de processos ASIS e desenhos de cenários TO BE);
Avaliar gaps e evolução de maturidade em business capabilities;
Atuar como interface entre áreas técnicas e de negócio, facilitando discussões multidisciplinares e orquestrando temas estratégicos.
REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS
Do que você precisa: Curso superior completo nas áreas de Engenharia, Administração ou Tecnologia ou Outras formações com experiencia comprovada em modelagem de processos, assessments, modelagem de novos negócios, estruturação de parcerias e negociação;
Conhecimentos em modelagem de negócios e visão estratégica aplicada a novos produtos, serviços ou parcerias;
Facilidade de relacionamento e networking, com postura colaborativa e influência sem autoridade formal; 
Conhecimentos de metodologias de análise e otimização de processos (BPM, Design Thinking, Lean, Customer Experience, Scenario Roadmapping, etc);
Noções de gestão de projetos (Scrum, Kanban ou similares);
Capacidade analítica e visão sistêmica para solução de problemas;
Habilidade com análise de dados, uso de soluções de IA e estudos de mercado para geração de insights e valor para o negócio;
Domínio pacote Office;
Inglês avançado (reuniões e apresentações);
Capacidade analítica e conceitual para solução de problemas;
Perfil comunicativo para realização de moderações, apresentações para públicos diversos e orquestração de temas estratégicos. ﻿Conhecimentos que te destacam: Atuação prévia em áreas de Planejamento estratégico, Governança e Performance e/ou Consultorias;
Passagem por empresas de mídia, grandes players de tecnologia ou ambientes digitais complexos;
Experiência em business development, inovação, processos ou consultoria;
Vivência em contextos que envolvam interação com múltiplas áreas e análise de problemas complexos;
Experiência em orquestração e negociação;
Conhecimento de ferramentas de AI.
ADDITIONAL INFORMATION
Por que vir para Globo:
Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.
Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação.
A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles.
Aqui, cada um faz a transformação acontecer.
Nossos processos seletivos estão acontecendo de forma 100% remota. #vempraglobo

title: Analyst
description:
Financial Analyst 
About You   You have the capacity to achieve much more than you are being asked. You chew up problems and spit them out. Do you want to stop wasting time commuting? Are you looking for a workplace that values you and your family, that values work-life balance? 
You are well organized and comfortable dealing with financial data. You are a natural at finance, and it has always just “clicked”. You are detail-oriented and love solving problems. You also love data – especially financial data! You would love a place where you can grow, interact with diverse clients, and be an important part of the team. 
You will work closely with our CFO team to help deliver unparalleled financial leadership to our clients through reporting, dashboarding, and ad-hoc analysis. You will be assisting with the finance functions of multiple companies across multiple industries. You will have a high  amount of autonomy, managing many of your own tasks and clients, all while working remotely .  Responsibilities   Conduct financial analysis, forecasting, and budgeting for multiple small to medium sized businesses  Develop and maintain financial models and reports, and analyze financial data to identify trends and opportunities  Collaborate with management teams to develop financial plans and strategies that align with business objectives  Monitor and report on financial performance, highlighting any significant issues or trends  Assist in the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reports  Provide ongoing support and guidance to management teams, including answering financial-related questions and providing financial analysis as needed  Participate in ad-hoc projects as required  Help our CFOs prepare for client calls by providing analysis and models to be reviewed  Qualifications   We believe that attitude and behavior are more important than degrees and  pedigrees. While we want you to be...  Strong analytical skills, with the ability to analyze complex financial data and identify trends and opportunities  Highly proficient in Excel (comfortable with data sets, using formulas)  Basic or greater understanding of database and data structure  Tech savvy  Basic or greater understanding of accounting (cash vs. accrual, income vs. cash flow)  Proficiency in financial modeling and forecasting techniques  Excellent communication skills, both verbal and written  BS/BA in Accounting or Finance is preferred,  Experience with Quick Books Online is a bonus  3+ years of experience in a Finance related role  ...we think it is just as important that you: 
Are kind to yourself and those around you  Have high initiative and are self-motivated  Execute, get the job done, and solve problems like a rock star  Have past successes  Can adapt to our environment, team, and clients  Who we  are  Prosper CFO is at the cutting edge of how accounting, tax, and CFO services are being provided. We are innovating the services themselves as well as how they are delivered and want to transform the client experience.   We are expanding through a growing reputation for excellence and client experience. We're adding new staff, raising expectations of our existing team, and shifting our company culture. We'd love for you to be a part of that.

title: Estagiário(a) de remuneração | flamengo - rj
description:
Fundada em 2022, a Vi V surgiu da união de importantes instituições de  saúde mental , com o objetivo de criar uma rede interligada de cuidado, da  baixa à alta complexidade . Hoje já somos mais de 1600 colaboradores e 900 leitos, estamos em 6 estados e nosso histórico de vidas transformadas está apenas começando. Já somos o  maior grupo de saúde mental  do país e temos o orgulho de poder atender a quem precisa, em diferentes etapas da jornada de cuidado, sempre com o mesmo objetivo: elevar a vida ao seu melhor
Estamos comprometidos em elevar a vida das pessoas ao seu melhor, por isso nossa rede de cuidados é o reflexo do que há de mais avançado em tratamentos psiquiátricos, com estrutura completa que inclui hospitais, clínicas e residências terapêuticas, todos interligados para proporcionar o melhor acolhimento aos pacientes.
Nós convidamos você a se tornar parte de uma equipe dinâmica e talentosa, onde poderá desenvolver suas habilidades e crescer profissionalmente. Na nossa empresa , valorizamos o trabalho em equipe, a inovação e o compromisso com a excelência. Se você busca um ambiente de trabalho estimulante, com oportunidades de aprendizado contínuo e projetos desafiadores, venha fazer parte do nosso time!
Nossa missão é elevar a vida, cuidando da saúde mental do Brasil. /n

Excel Avançado;

title: Jr knowledge analyst - oil & gas
description:

In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible. title: Garantista
description:
Somos o Grupo Rio Veículos, um grupo de concessionárias multimarcas que atua com sucesso há mais de uma década na cidade do Rio de Janeiro.
Nossa história começa com a aquisição da MIT RIO, em 2010, com lojas no Leblon e no Centro do Rio. O sucesso comercial da marca na gestão de vendas e serviços e no modelo de relacionamento com os clientes foi tão expressivo, que tornou-se imperativo replicá-lo no desenvolvimento de negócios com outras marcas. Assim surgiu a Prime Rio, concessionária Jeep, em 2016, no bairro carioca de São Conrado, que logo se estabeleceu e passou a ser a principal referência de vendas da marca na região metropolitana do Rio de Janeiro.
Seguindo a trilha, aceitamos o desafio de utilizar o mesmo modelo exitoso de negócios para as marcas francesas Peugeot e Citroen. Desta forma, o grupo fundou a Paris Rio, em 2018, no bairro da Barra da Tijuca, onde, com o apoio da montadora, vem conquistando avanços importantes para na comunicação da qualidade das marcas e dos modelos dos veículos, bem como na excelência dos serviços prestados aos clientes. Merece destaque o prêmio de melhor concessionária no setor de pós-vendas de 2020, na região sudeste e, ainda, o fato de ser escolhida no Brasil como uma de duas concessionárias que realizam a venda e manutenção do carro elétrico Peugeot e-208.  Recentemente, em 2021, a Paris Rio abriu outra loja no bairro do Recreio dos Bandeirantes, consolidando a sua posição na região.
Em 2020, foi a vez da Fiat, no Centro da Cidade. O Grupo Rio, mais uma vez na vanguarda, aceitou o desafio de abrir a primeira loja conceito do Rio de Janeiro, ampliando a sua influência local e consolidando o seu modelo de negócios já consagrado na comercialização de suas outras marcas.
Vale destacar ainda a venda de veículos seminovos exclusivos com autenticidade garantida!

Acreditamos que o que conquistamos e o que ainda está por vir é fruto de uma cultura centrada no relacionamento com os clientes e fortemente impulsionada pelo time de colaboradores que reunimos. title: Freelance supply chain consultant - ai trainer
description:
Mindrift connects specialists with project-based AI opportunities for leading tech companies, focused on testing, evaluating, and improving AI systems. Participation is project-based, not permanent employment. About the Role As a Procurement & Supply Chain Expert on this project, you will design realistic disruption scenarios based on your hands-on experience, define expected outcomes and mitigation strategies, and evaluate AI-generated recommendations for accuracy, completeness, and business relevance.
What this opportunity involves  While each project involves unique tasks, contributors may: 
Designing realistic supply chain disruption scenarios (e.g. supplier delays, quantity changes, logistics issues, quality failures) grounded in real-world manufacturing and procurement contexts
Defining expected outcomes and appropriate mitigation strategies for each scenario
Evaluating AI-generated responses and recommendations against real-world business logic
Assessing outputs for accuracy, completeness, and relevance within ERP environments (particularly Microsoft Dynamics 365, Coupa, Jaggaer, Ariba (SAP))
Contributing to structured data creation and validation tasks following defined guidelines and frameworks What we look for  
Minimum 4 years of hands-on experience in procurement, supply chain, or purchasing, ideally in a manufacturing environment
Strong working knowledge of procurement workflows: purchase orders, vendor management, inventory, and production planning
Hands-on experience with ERP systems such as SAP, Oracle, or Microsoft Dynamics 365
Proven ability to design and reason through supply chain disruption scenarios and mitigation approaches
Solid understanding of disruption types: delays, shortages, quality issues, and logistics challenges
Knowledge of Incoterms and transportation/logistics management
Familiarity with BOM structures and production planning processes
Experience with supplier performance metrics (OTIF, lead times, quality scores)
Analytical mindset with the ability to assess AI outputs against real-world business logic
Experience with data validation, structured data entry, or annotation tasks
Clear written communication in English How it works  Apply → Pass qualification(s) → Join a project → Complete tasks → Get paid
Project time expectations  For this project, tasks are estimated to require around 10-20 hours per week during active phases, based on project requirements. This is an estimate, not a guaranteed workload, and applies only while the project is active. 
Compensation On this project, contributors can earn up to $50 per hour equivalent , depending on their level and pace of contribution. Compensation varies across projects depending on scope, complexity, and required expertise. Please note that other projects on the platform may offer different earning levels based on their requirements.

title: Senior associate
description:
Description :
What We Do  
Executive Search Senior Associates play a critical role in the execution of all facets of the executive recruiting lifecycle, from candidate identification to placement. Working closely with our expert Search Partners & Principals (Consultants), Senior Associates build upon their existing professional skills in a hands-on environment and continue to receive world class mentorship and professional development in an apprenticeship-style method. Our Senior Associates drive most aspects of the recruitment process, from developing the search strategy with the Consultant through managing its execution. Senior Associates also get exposure to business development activities. The search process includes working with clients to develop position specifications; interviewing, and assessing prospective candidates and building a pipeline of qualified candidates for active searches meeting the client’s requirements; developing the candidate relationship; and candidate referencing. An integral part of a Senior Associate’s role is assisting with client relationship management, sustaining relationships with senior executives and guiding candidates through their recruitment journey.
While learning the Search industry, Senior Associates invest significant time researching and learning about various industries, executive roles and functions, and do so in collaboration with colleagues across the globe. The Senior Associate role provides a great degree of visibility, significant responsibility and the opportunity for high impact with an excellent career track potential on a well-defined path. 
Role Responsibilities
Research & Writing: 
Developing position specification(s) and creating an effective search strategy in tandem with the Consultant.
Conducting industry specific and client company research, mapping the executive talent landscape to bring market insights to the Consultant/Client. 
Assisting Consultants in preparing business development materials to present to prospective and current clients.  Internal and External Communication: 
Contacting prospective candidates to elicit interest in client opportunities, obtaining referrals, and/or collecting market intelligence and feedback. 
Conducting in-depth interviews to assess candidate qualifications and fit to position specifications.
Writing candidate assessments and presenting candidates to clients.
Managing candidate relationships throughout the entire life cycle of the search and keeping the Consultant abreast of candidate updates.
Contributing to client relationship management with the Consultant. Living Our Values: 
Partnering well across a multitude of stakeholders with the aim of developing productive and trusting relationships with colleagues across the firm. 
Fostering an environment of collaboration; viewed as a team player. 
Acting as a culture carrier; contributes to firm, practice and/or office initiatives. 
Demonstrating self-awareness, humility, empathy, and open-mindedness in the workplace.  Ethics & Quality: 
Maintaining the accuracy, quality, and integrity of all Search information in our various internal and external research tools.
Maintaining status reports and client ready reports for both internal and external presentation(s) to Consultant and Client. 
Managing multiple concurrent projects and completing high quality deliverables on time. 
Acting with the highest regard to professionalism, confidentiality, and ethics. 
Succeeding and persisting through challenges, motivated to do the right thing.  Basic Role Qualifications 4-6 years professional experience or a minimum of 3+ years of transferable recruiting experience.
An undergraduate BA/BS degree is required.
Exhibits skill and developing mastery of professional communications, displaying adeptness in writing, articulating, and delivering information with confidence and impact.
Exhibits a proven ability to collaborate with external clients and candidates, showcasing adeptness in influencing and fostering productive partnerships. Preferred Role Qualifications   Prior experience in full life cycle recruiting in Executive Search, Contingent Search or In-House Talent Acquisition or other industry requiring applied sales and research skills strongly preferred. 
Proven success simultaneously managing multiple projects and working across teams.

title: Banco de talentos | estágios
description:
Que tal trabalhar em um clube de futebol referência em gestão? Após um árduo trabalho de reestruturação, o Clube de Regatas do Flamengo tornou-se uma das marcas de maior credibilidade no cenário nacional, atraindo grandes parceiros comerciais e investindo pesado em infraestrutura e recursos humanos. Aqui a gente procura os melhores craques para todas as modalidades - inclusive nos setores administrativos! Dos mais jovens talentos com sede de aprendizado aos profissionais mais gabaritados e experientes para gerir nossas equipes, aqui tem espaço para todos, de todas as cores, crenças e gêneros. 
Venha ser um dos craques do maior clube poliesportivo do Brasil! O Flamengo é a maior marca de futebol e o maior clube poliesportivo da América Latina. Conhecido por ter a Maior Torcida do Mundo, com mais de 48 milhões de rubro-negros apaixonados espalhados pelo mundo, foi fundado em 1895 e, desde então, coleciona títulos em diversas modalidades esportivas ao longo de sua história centenária. No futebol, carro-chefe do clube, o Flamengo é octacampeão brasileiro, pentacampeão da Copa do Brasil, maior vencedor do Campeonato Carioca com 39 títulos, tricampeão da Copa Libertadores e campeão mundial de clubes, taças erguidas por grandes craques do futebol que vestiram o Manto Sagrado e, é claro, pela Nação Rubro-Negra, sempre atuante como 12º jogador.
O clube colheu os frutos e os números se transformaram em resultado esportivo, com troféus erguidos pelo futebol e pelos esportes olímpicos, conquistando campeonatos nacionais de remo, basquete, ginástica artística, polo aquático, nado artístico e até mesmo esportes eletrônicos. Nos últimos Jogos Olímpicos, em Tóquio e Paris, o Mais Querido teve diversos representantes e fez bonito com as conquistas históricas das ginastas Rebeca Andrade, Jade Barbosa, Lorrane Oliveira e Flavia Saraiva, do canoísta Isaquias Queiroz e da judoca Rafaela Silva, todos atletas rubro-negros.
Já pensou em poder fazer parte de tudo isso?
Trabalhar no Flamengo é diferente de tudo que você já viveu… Trabalhar com paixão é mágico e muito especial. Ser um colaborador do Flamengo é ver a história sendo escrita de perto, é ter a emoção como colega de trabalho, é sentir como é gratificante fazer parte de grandes conquistas, é fazer parte de uma família e de uma Nação. Venha trabalhar conosco, participar do presente, construir o futuro e valorizar o passado de uma instituição centenária que mexe com o coração de mais de 48 milhões de apaixonados.
Eternos ídolos já vestiram o Manto Sagrado, grandes craques formam nossas equipes, excelentes profissionais constroem a história de sucesso do Flamengo... O próximo pode ser você!
RAÇA… Todo mundo sabe que quem joga pelo Flamengo tem que honrar o Manto Sagrado! Aqui, valorizamos muito o comprometimento, a dedicação, a superação, a resiliência. Para quem é craque do Mengão, não tem bola perdida: a gente entra firme na dividida e se destaca pelo profissionalismo. A busca é incessante pela excelência! …AMOR E PAIXÃO! Pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem e pelo Flamengo! Você verá que é muito fácil ter paixão pelo seu trabalho com a gente. Ética, transparência, honestidade, profissionalismo, respeito e integridade são titulares do nosso time em todas as partidas. Estamos sempre juntos com garra, otimismo e alegria para vencer! CRAQUE FAZEMOS EM CASA Zelo pelas pessoas, desenvolvimento e constante aperfeiçoamento. Aqui no Flamengo, queremos ensinar, mas também aprender com você! Muitas são as oportunidades de evoluir com o espírito rubro-negro. Somos um time e uma família! Venha fazer parte dessa equipe! /nDesejável disponibilidade para estagiar por pelo menos um ano. /n
Estar cursando Ensino superior;
Disponibilidade para estagiar presencialmente na Gávea, Vargem Grande ou Recreio dos Bandeirantes (a confirmar dependendo da vaga);
Proatividade e vontade de aprender.

title: Analista de inovação senior
description:
O que faz a gente ser Super?
Somos uma empresa que valoriza as pessoas e tudo o que elas representam: a energia das ideias, da contribuição, da parceria e da colaboração.
Por isso, nos dedicamos a construir um ambiente de trabalho propício ao desenvolvimento humano e profissional dos nossos colaboradores, sempre incentivando a interação, a participação ativa e o crescimento. Gostamos de quem acrescenta, porque acreditamos que o sucesso vem da soma da energia com a colaboração.
E o que nós fazemos exatamente?
Somos uma empresa do Grupo SHV Energy, líder mundial na distribuição de GLP e uma das principais distribuidoras de gás LP no Brasil, com mais de 75 anos de atuação.
Possuímos o mais moderno parque engarrafador da América Latina e contamos com mais de 20 unidades industriais distribuídas pelo país, de norte a sul.
Nossos mais de 4 mil colaboradores nos enchem de orgulho pelo que somos e pelo que fazemos, levando energia para mais de 10 milhões de famílias brasileiras, alcançando locais onde nenhum outro tipo de energia consegue chegar. Além disso, atendemos mais de 60 mil clientes empresariais, desde pequenos comércios até grandes indústrias, incluindo o agronegócio.

• Experiencia na área;

• Inglês avançado

Experiência em start-up, consultoria em Inovação ou em áreas de Inovação em grandes empresas, principalmente do setor varejista e de bens de consumo (capacidade de execução e entrega em ciclos mais curtos). /n
Objetivo do Cargo: Atuar como agente de transformação,  liderando iniciativas de inovação e transformação digital que impulsionem a competitividade, a eficiência operacional e a experiência do cliente.  Esta posição tem como propósito fortalecer uma cultura  de inovação contínua, conectando tendências emergentes às necessidades estratégicas da Supergasbras e promovendo soluções que gerem valor sustentável para o negócio .
Responsabilidades: Programas de Inovação Interna:  Atuar junto ao time na gestão e evolução dos programas de intraempreendedorismo Influenciadores de Inovação  e Chega Junto para Inovar , promovendo o engajamento de colaboradores, fortalecendo a cultura de inovação e estimulando a participação ativa em iniciativas estratégicas. Mapeamento de Tendências e Tecnologias:  Mapear e analisar tendências, tecnologias e inovações com potencial de impacto, antecipando oportunidades, orientando decisões estratégicas e solucionando desafios complexos da organização. Processos de Discovery:  Conduzir processos estruturados de discovery para identificar desafios relevantes, compreender as necessidades dos usuários e propor soluções inovadoras com base em metodologias inovadoras como Design Thinking, Service Design, Lean Startup, Agile e outras. Prototipagem e Experimentação:  Facilitar a colaboração entre equipes multidisciplinares para desenvolver, testar e iterar rapidamente protótipos, provas de conceito e MVPs, garantindo agilidade e qualidade nas entregas.
